newsitem.title: USA: Pilgrim America issues 18.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Pilgrim America issues 18.1 mln shares.

text.p: Pilgrim America Prime Rate Trust said it will issue 18.1 million common shares pursuant to its one for five non-transferrable rights offering which expired on November 12, 1996.
It said total net proceeds to the trust from the rights offering will be about $157.7 million after the deduction of offering expenses.
Total net assets will equal about $1.024 billion, it added.
Pilgrim said the board of trustees decided not to issue additional shares to honor over subscriptions.

Pilgrim America Prime Rate Trust invests in a portfolio of senior, collateralized corporate bank loans whose rates float with the prime lending rate as posted by major banks or LIBOR (London Inter-Bank Offered Rate).
